about: 회계 II › 계약조회 [계약번호] → 계약수정(2026-10-13 원본 실측): 계약일자 뒤 ' -N', 버튼 저장(F8) · 복사 · 닫기 · 삭제 · H. [H] '이력' 창 [YYYY/MM/DD -N] 신규 → 저장하고 다시 열면 수정 줄. [복사] → 계약입력(계약명 비움 · 다음 계약코드 · 줄 그대로). [삭제] '전표를 삭제하겠습니까?' / '- 계약' → 목록에서 빠진다. 만든 항목은 끝에 지운다.

steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const c='E'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-수정창',unitPrice:10000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'PERIODIC',salesAccountId:null})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body.find((x)=>x.name==='월말청구');const p=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const r=await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-수정창계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:'01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08,09,10,11,12',quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:null}]});sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',r.body.id);sessionStorage.setItem('bcCode',r.body.code);return r.status})()
